# Babellino

> Babellino is a self-contained offline AI translator in development, with an 8-inch touchscreen for live, face-to-face translation.

AI runs on the device; no internet connection is needed during use.
Final hardware, supported languages, pricing, and availability have not been announced.
The website's device illustration, sample conversation, and translated headlines are illustrative, not final hardware or confirmed language support.

## Website

- [Babellino](https://babellino.com/): Official prelaunch website.
- [The device](https://babellino.com/#the-device): Product direction and intended features.
- [How it works](https://babellino.com/#how-it-works): Speech, on-device AI, and translation.
- [Questions](https://babellino.com/#questions): Offline operation, unannounced languages, and concept hardware.
